W.note: Restrained line-art cards with real labeled variant radios, add/added/error states and a demo failure toggle, but cards are tall with dead space under the button and the cart sits far below the grid.

X.note: The most complete cart (quantity steppers, free-shipping bar, totals, disabled-until-filled checkout, search, sort, filters) but gradient initial tiles look dated and decorative, long names wrap awkwardly, and a card appears clipped at the bottom of the desktop grid.

Y.note: The densest layout that still reads well, with a clear search pill, cart badge, stock warnings, quantity steppers and a sticky summary, though product names wrap to three lines in the narrow desktop columns.

Z.note: Very restrained, with clean line art, squared variant chips and a clear sold-out state, but the desktop grid leaves the right side empty, one name truncates, and there is no real cart summary or checkout.
